checks.command:
set -e
export BEADS_NO_DAEMON=1 BD_NO_DAEMON=true
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$root" && make build
d=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$d" && git init -q .
"$root/bd" init --quiet --prefix demo
"$root/bd" create "phase 0 rev" --id demo-w1-p0a -t task >/dev/null
"$root/bd" export -o .beads/issues.jsonl
"$root/bd" import -i .beads/issues.jsonl

set -e
export BEADS_NO_DAEMON=1 BD_NO_DAEMON=true
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
d=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$d" && git init -q .
"$root/bd" init --quiet --prefix demo
printf '%s\n' '{"id":"other-bad1","title":"foreign","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task"}' > foreign.jsonl
"$root/bd" import -i foreign.jsonl 2>&1 || true

set -e
export BEADS_NO_DAEMON=1 BD_NO_DAEMON=true
bd_bin="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/bd"
for r in farmplanner duke investing teaching; do
  d=$(mktemp -d)
  cp -r "$HOME/projects/$r/.beads" "$d/.beads"
  ( cd "$d" && git init -q . && "$bd_bin" import -i .beads/issues.jsonl )
done

set -e
export BEADS_NO_DAEMON=1 BD_NO_DAEMON=true
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
d=$(mktemp -d) && cd "$d" && git init -q .
PATH="$root:$PATH"
bd init --quiet --prefix demo
printf '%s\n' '{"id":"other-bad1","title":"foreign","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task"}' > .beads/issues.jsonl
sh .git/hooks/post-merge 2>&1 >/dev/null
